scripts.build: pnpm --filter @venda/nuxt build && pnpm --filter @venda/landing build && pnpm --filter @venda/server build
scripts.test: node --test scripts/spacing.test.mjs scripts/content-server.test.mjs && pnpm --filter @venda/richtext test && pnpm --filter @venda/content test && pnpm --filter @venda/contract test && pnpm --filter @venda/core test && pnpm --filter @venda/server test && pnpm --filter @venda/admin test && pnpm --filter @venda/views-core test && pnpm --filter @venda/editor-writer test && pnpm --filter @venda/admin-app test && pnpm --filter @venda/nuxt test
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @venda/richtext typecheck && pnpm --filter @venda/content typecheck && pnpm --filter @venda/contract typecheck && pnpm --filter @venda/core typecheck && pnpm --filter @venda/server typecheck && pnpm --filter @venda/nuxt typecheck && pnpm --filter @venda/admin typecheck && pnpm --filter @venda/admin-app typecheck && pnpm --filter @venda/landing typecheck
scripts.lint: prettier --check . && pnpm --filter "./apps/*" --filter "./packages/*" run lint && eslint . && oxlint --deny-warnings
scripts.lint:fix: prettier --write . && pnpm --filter "./apps/*" --filter "./packages/*" run lint:fix && eslint . --fix && oxlint --fix && prettier --write .
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm fallow
